Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.
Stan keeps hearing the tune of an ice cream van but it's not there! Seals are singing, whistles are blowing and birds are barking! What's going on.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
The pups find kittens inside an old building in 'The Crew Demolishes A Soap Factory', then in 'The Crew Musically Demolishes A Building', Motor drums while the pups do demolition. (S5, ep 12)
Talon with a special patient in 'The Ice Phoenix', then in 'A Winter's Tail', snowed in at the Clinic, the trainees help Ariel celebrate new traditions.
A magical card arrives in the Little Kingdom, inviting everyone to a party at Granny and Granpapa Thistle's castle in the clouds.
Ben and Holly are having fun playing in the meadow. Holly gets frustrated when Ben uses his elf skills to win all the games, and Ben gets frustrated when Holly uses her magic skills.
When the police visit the school, officers Panda and Squirrel teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
Pups Save the Babysitter: Roles are reversed when Priya has to save the Paw Patrol when animal hijinks occur at the farm. (S14, ep 2b)

Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.
The youngsters visit the zoo where they are shown around by zookeepers Mr Lion, Mrs Crocodile and Mr Giraffe.
Pups Save the Porcupine: When the Turbots accidentally bring a sleepy porcupine to Adventure Bay, the prickly critter gets loose and causes trouble everywhere it goes! (S14, ep 1b)
Peppa and her family are on holiday in Australia. They are visiting the Kangaroo family, who take them to explore the outback on their first day.
The pups find kittens inside an old building in 'The Crew Demolishes A Soap Factory', then in 'The Crew Musically Demolishes A Building', Motor drums while the pups do demolition.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.
Mammoth: Tim, Tommy and Tia find a lost mammoth in their house. (S1, ep 24)
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.
Rocket Ramp: Tim tries to help Tia face the new Rocket track ride. (S1, ep 51)

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Balloon: Tia's new balloon gets stuck in a tree, so Tim tries to get it down. (S1, ep 3)
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
Super Smash Race: Today is the big race! When Crusher cheats and sends Zeg and Blaze far away, they must get back to the race, to slam and wham their way to a smash-tacular finish! (S7, ep 25)
Pups Save the Babysitter: Roles are reversed when Priya has to save the Paw Patrol when animal hijinks occur at the farm. (S14, ep 2b).
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

While repairing a sea wall, Sandy and Carly accidentally cut off a consortium of crabs from the shore. When the crabs start to wreak havoc among the farm animals, the duo must direct them back to the water.
Pups Save the Porcupine: When the Turbots accidentally bring a sleepy porcupine to Adventure Bay, the prickly critter gets loose and causes trouble everywhere it goes! (S14, ep 1b).
Kit and Sam find out whether the rats in the North American wetlands are really rats. When two pied flycatchers build a nest and one goes missing, concerns about a predator arise.
pr.sub: The Mysterious Swamp Rats / The Vanishing Mr. Blue

pr.d: Fairy Festival: 5...4...3...2...1. It's fairy o'clock - and the start of a fantastic festival, featuring rides, games, cotton candy and a new friend with a flower contest dream. (S2, ep 6)
Porter's donut maker in 'Pups save the Donuts', then in 'Pups save the Kitties', The Ruff-Ruff Pack takes over Humdinger's lair and run off with his kitties.

Who is Paddington's Special Visitor that Jonathan and Judy have helped come from afar? It's the last night of Hanukkah and Mr Gruber's Hanukkiah breaks before he can light the final candle, how can another be found in time?
pr.sub: Paddington's Special Visitor; Paddington Celebrates Hanukkah

pr.d: The Elf School: Holly and Nanny Plum join Ben at Elf School, where the Wise Old Elf tells them that strictly no magic should be used. Holly finds it difficult until Nanny uses a little magic to help.
The dollhouse delivery is a special plant called an Itty Bitty Blossom that goes from newborn to full-grown in one day. Gabby and Pandy have to take care of them.
Journey to the Centre of the Earth: Naughty Daisy and Poppy magic their teacher, Mrs Fotheringill to the centre of the Earth, so Granpapa Thistle leads Ben and Holly on a rescue mission.
Paddington and his friends help PC Wells solve a mysterious case. Inspired by Aunt Lucy's special recipe, the Browns start a takeaway business from their home, but it proves to be hard work.
pr.sub: Paddington's Adventure Club Cracks The Case! / Paddington And Aunt Lucy's Special Recipe

pr.d: Grandpa's Robot: Grandpa is building something in his shed. It is his latest pet project. It's a robot called Frank.

Igloo: It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They then hide away in it during the snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and Peppa's igloo too.
Coach Peppa: Daddy Pig's marathon training continues. There isn't long to go before the big day! Peppa takes the role as Daddy's coach and, with George, devises lots of fun games to help. (S8, ep 25)
Charity Shop: Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George decide to take all the things they don't use anymore to the charity shop, which raises money to help others.
Paddington has to decide whether to support England or Peru before the football match, but he loves both countries. It's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still time for one last adventure.
pr.sub: Paddington's Football DIlemma; Paddington Has to Say Goodbye

pr.d: The Holiday: Peppa and her family have gone on holiday, staying in a teeny tiny little holiday home near the beach. They discover that even when it rains, they can have lots of fun.
Bat and Ball: Madame Gazelle decides to teach the children how to play Bat and Ball, but when it is her turn she hits the ball too far!
Winter Games: Peppa and her friends have fun and games in the snow.
Mandy Mouse's Birthday: Today is Mandy Mouse's birthday, and as a special treat, Mandy is going to Cheese World with her friends. It is the most fun ever!
Storm and the Lost Talisman: Gargamel is looking for a talisman that will help him to find the Smurfies' village. Storm decides that she's going to get there before him. But it's a trap! (S4, ep 10)
Auntie, Uncle Pig, and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late; she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
It's autumn and the Elves and Nanny Plum are busy clearing up all the leaves. Suddenly the squirrels arrive with a mission to store acorns in the Great Elf Tree. Acorn Day has arrived.

Peppa and her family are watching television when it suddenly stops working. While Grampy Rabbit attempts to repair it, the family acquires a new, multifunctional TV. However, they soon realise their old set was preferable.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
Nanny Plum is teaching the fairy girls some important fairy rules when she is blown away, trapped in a tree, dropped in a stream and covered in mud.
Peppa and George play in their pool, helping garden animals cool off. When rain arrives, both the animals and Peppa are pleased. The rainfall forms muddy puddles, which Peppa loves for jumping.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.
Farmer Al's harvest machine goes haywire in 'Pups Stop a Super Shaker', then in 'Pups Save a Flying Farmhouse', Farmer Al has a wild dream that his animals start acting like humans. (S8, ep 16)
When tasked with prepping hay bales for a huge hay delivery, Terence and Carly add a little fun to the work by setting out to create the tallest hay tower ever.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn that it is not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the Earth.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.
When the engines have the day off, Percy reluctantly agrees to referee their obstacle course race. But with each race, the teams get upset with Percy's rulings.
It is a special day because Mummy and Daddy Pig have big news to tell Peppa and George, but they struggle to wait!
Uncle Otis is hurling down Jake's Mountain in a runaway mine car. Ryder and the Pups need to rescue him before it crashes.
Grandad clears some caterpillars off his veg and safely puts them in a box for rehoming, but when Stan checks, all he finds is a strange object..
Mayor Humdinger and his mother help Mayor Goodway look for a rare tulip in 'Pups Save a Chicken Tulip', then in 'Pups Stop an Xtreme Shark', The Pups save Danny when a stunt goes wrong. (S8, ep 12)
Daring Danny X is harnessed over a canyon eating an extreme lunch when the wind blows him upside down.
Stan keeps hearing the tune of an ice cream van but it's not there! Seals are singing, whistles are blowing and birds are barking! What's going on.

Paddington and the Browns rescue pufflings, who get lost around the campsite instead of taking their first flight. Paddington enjoys a diving adventure with Jonathan and Judy - but where is her necklace?
pr.sub: Paddington's Puffling Rescue; Paddington Goes Under the Sea

pr.d: Jade faces Mr Best in a dance off in 'Dance Off', then in 'The Show Must Go On', the Marsups save the twins play. (S1, ep 3)
When Tia misses the Spinny Star, Tim tries to recreate it for her.
Tim and Kai try to uncover trinkets buried at the beach.
Tim, Tommy, Tia and Dad get stuck on a remote asteroid.

The beach is a mess, but all the litter must be cleared up in time for the beach party that everyone has been looking forward to. As the summer holidays come to an end, the time arrives to say goodbye to new friends.
pr.sub: Paddington's Beach Clean Up; Paddington's Holiday Farewell

pr.d: Miss Cookie's Nature Trail: Miss Cookie's class is out on a nature trail, in the Little Kingdom! It is up to Ben and Holly to prevent the elves and fairies being discovered!
Miss Jolly's Riding Club: Ben, Holly and their friends go on a snail trek with Miss Jolly.
Paddington wants to make a special cake. Paddington and Mateo form a table tennis team.
pr.sub: Paddington Celebrates Mrs. Bird's Day; Paddington the Table 🎾 [Tennis] Tennis Champ!

pr.d: The Elf Band: Snobby King and Queen Marigold are coming to visit the Little Kingdom, and Holly and her Mummy and Daddy enlist the Elf Band to impress them.
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is a hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
Mummy Pig and Peppa are at Granny Pig's house. They find Mummy's old patchwork quilt that Granny made for her as a baby. Peppa decides she'd like to make one for the baby.
The Frog Prince: Holly accidentally turns Ben into a frog. With the help of her friends, Holly tries to turn Ben back into an elf but instead turns him into a bird and then a rabbit!
Peppa is out with Suzy and Granny Sheep. They come across an old van that Miss Rabbit is recycling. Granny Sheep decides she would like to turn it into an art van.
Granny Sheep is driving Vanessa, the art van along the road with Peppa, Suzy, Pedro, Mandy, Molly and Danny. They are taking her to the boat yard, for her first-ever outing.
The bath tap at the Little Castle is dripping, so the elf plumber is called. It's a bigger job than first expected, but with King and Queen Marigolds coming round, there's not much time.
Dinerstore: Tim and Tommy help out at the DinerStore. (S1, ep 42)
While Mummy and Daddy Pig attend a refresher antenatal class, Peppa and George join Miss Rabbit's Sibling School, and learn about what to expect when the baby arrives.
Peppa is so excited to meet her new baby brother or sister, but they are taking forever to arrive until suddenly Mummy Pig announces the baby is coming, now.
Parents: The kids become the parents and the parents become the kids. (S1, ep 12)
Mr Elf has built a new boat to replace the one Big Bad Barry ate. He is nervous when the king commands him to take them on a cruise to a tropical paradise.
Peppa is given the very important task of suggesting names for the new baby. She thinks of all sorts of names, but they aren't quite right.
Tickets: Tim and Kai compete to get Terri's spare Space-Land ticket. (S1, ep 47)
The nurse visits, and she decides that today's visit should be all about how to hold a baby. The nurse shows Peppa a special way for a small person to safely hold a baby.

There's a pirate-themed holiday in town, but Zuma isn't in a festive mood. His revamped persona gets tested when a real pirate arrives, bent on hidden treasure and ready to destroy the town to get it!
The Shut Shoe Box Mystery: Grandad clears some caterpillars off his veg and safely puts them in a box for rehoming, but when Stan checks, all he finds is a strange object... (S1, ep 22)
Dr Brown Bear suggests Peppa and George have their hearing checked. The audiologist discovers George has a moderate hearing loss and suggests George tries a hearing aid.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his new hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of a muddy puddle.
The Phantom Ice Cream Van: Stan keeps hearing the tune of an ice cream van but it's not there! Seals are singing, whistles are blowing and birds are barking! What's going on? (S1, ep 23)
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay.
Grandpa Pig found his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to leave! Peppa and Suzy look after him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable.
Clarion and Annette help Dr. Talon with a special patient in 'The Ice Phoenix', then in 'A Winter's Tail', snowed in at the Clinic, the trainees help Ariel celebrate new traditions. (S1, ep 16)
A magical card arrives in the Little Kingdom, inviting everyone to a party at Granny and Granpapa Thistle's castle in the clouds.
Ben and Holly are having fun playing in the meadow. Holly gets frustrated when Ben uses his elf skills to win all the games. Ben gets frustrated when Holly uses her magic skills.
PAW Patrol is a CG action-adventure preschool series starring a pack of six heroic puppies led by a tech-savvy 10-year-old boy named Ryder.

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.
The Windsor Ruby is missing in 'Paddington's Adventure Club Cracks The Case!', then in 'Paddington And Aunt Lucy's Special Recipe', the Browns set up a takeaway, but it's hard work.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!
Peppa and her family go to the water park for an adventure, and Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park, but the first thing to do is to put on a swimsuit.
A game between England and Peru causes 'Paddington's Football Dilemma', then in 'Paddington Has To Say Goodbye', it's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still one more adventure.
Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure.

Madame Gazelle takes the class through a simple tots workout at Peppa's playground that uses spinning hoops. Though they have fun playing with the hoops, they have a hard time spinning them around their waists as directed.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.
Farmer hires Willow's pet carnivorous plant to watch over his crops. Papa Smurf prepares a potion to boost his strength, but its effects are heavily altered due to a spider's intrusion.
Acorn Day: It's autumn and the Elves and Nanny Plum are busy clearing up all the leaves. Suddenly the squirrels arrive with a mission to store acorns in the Great Elf Tree. Acorn Day has arrived!
Auntie, Uncle Pig and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late - she even stayed up later than the Daddies.
Peppa and family are watching TV... until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything... but it doesn't beat their old TV.
Nanny Plum's Lesson: Nanny Plum is teaching the fairy girls some important fairy rules when she is blown away, trapped in a tree, dropped in a stream and covered in mud!

Peppa and George are in Granny and Grandpa Pig's Garden. Granny's friends are playing folk music! They play music for Grandpa Pig and then Grandpa Pig makes apple juice for everyone.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised there are extra rules she doesn't have in her own house like no shoes indoors and no eating peanuts.

When Grandma gives Tim a hat she made herself, Tim is super excited, but unfortunately it keeps getting in the way.

Tim and Tia build a time machine to avoid confronting Dad and telling him the truth.
