pr.d: Are the rats in the wetlands really rats? We find out in 'The Mysterious Swamp Rats', and then in 'The Vanishing Mr. Blue', a Pied Flycatcher goes missing! (S2, ep 4)
A tiny top hat delivery leads to a dazzling day for new magician Baby Box. Meanwhile, her closest friends help her perform a boppin'-and-hoppin' trick.
Gabby and Pandy share their new Meow Meow Mail with Cakey and work on a cure for a case of the hiccups.
Who is Paddington's Special visitor that Jonathan and Judy have helped come from afar? // It's the last night of Hanukkah and Mr Gruber's Hanukkiah breaks before he can light the final candle.
Snooty King and Queen Marigold are coming to visit, but when the King's new clothes get dirty Nanny cleans them, along with the King's old clothes - and shrinks them all.
Holly breaks her wand and must go to the Wand Factory, at the bottom of the Great Elf Tree, to get it fixed.
Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play the recorder. They practise a lot at home, then put on a performance for all the parents to enjoy.
The Windsor Ruby is missing in 'Paddington's Adventure Club Cracks The Case!', then in 'Paddington And Aunt Lucy's Special Recipe', the Browns set up a takeaway, but it's hard work! (S3, ep 23)
Everybody is once again skiing on the mountains, but an unpredictable Mummy Pig showcases her skiing skills.
Madame Gazelle sets the children a creative task of making masks. There are carrot masks, robot masks, and even pretty butterfly masks. The only thing missing is lots and lots of glitter.

Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete. Peppa, Mummy and George all decide to go with Daddy and enjoy a train journey, where they sing to pass the time.

Peppa and her friends head to the trampoline park where Miss Rabbit shows them how to bounce. As Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Mummy Sheep watch the children play, they decide they want to have a go at trampolining.
A game between England and Peru causes 'Paddington's Football Dilemma', then in 'Paddington Has To Say Goodbye', it's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still one more adventure. (S3, ep 24)
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy.

Peppa and her family are watching television when it suddenly stops working. While Grampy Rabbit attempts to repair it, the family acquires a new, multifunctional TV. However, they soon realise their old set was preferable.
Farmer hires Yippy, Willow's plant, to watch over his crops in 'Farmer's New Pet', and then in 'Spider Smurf, Papa Smurf makes a revitalizing potion that turns him into a spider.
The elf and fairy children learn all about how the rubbish from a picnic can be recycled into beautiful new toys.
Staying Up Late: Auntie, Uncle Pig and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late - she even stayed up later than the Daddies!
New TV: Peppa and family are watching TV... until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything... but it doesn't beat their old TV.
Ben is in training for the elf games, and Holly wants to join in but the rules state there is absolutely no flying or magic allowed. Ben gives Holly a chance to join in without using magic.

Indoor Adventure: A storm cancels Peppa and her family's adventure plans so they decide to take it inside. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and have a campfire in the attic.

Indoor Adventure: A storm cancels Peppa and her family's adventure plans so they decide to take it inside. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and have a campfire in the attic.
When Thomas and Percy transport an unlucky boxcar of bananas, Thomas starts to have bad luck wherever he goes and must find a way to break the curse.
Folk Music Band: Peppa and George are in Granny and Grandpa Pig's Garden. Granny's friends are playing folk music! They play music for Grandpa Pig and then Grandpa Pig makes apple juice for everyone!
Sid Swashbuckle pretends to be a legendary ghost in 'Pups Vs. Ouchy Paws', then in 'Pups Save a Glow-in-the-Dark Party', an alien zaps unwitting party guests into floating space bubbles.
Calling Kylie: It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn it's not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the earth.
When Nia causes an accident that sends sand into Tess's gears during a big delivery, Nia tries Sandy's new super-grease as a solution.
House Rules: While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised there are extra rules she doesn't have in her own house like no shoes indoors and no eating peanuts.
House Rules: While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised there are extra rules she doesn't have in her own house like no shoes indoors and no eating peanuts.
Stan is intrigued when he spots strange lights in the night sky. Grumblestunk thinks it's an alien invasion, but Stan and Gran are not so sure.
Pups Go for the Gold: Uncle Otis is hurling down Jake's Mountain in a runaway mine car! Ryder and the Pups need to rescue him before it crashes. [SL]
Rubble dreams of meeting his alien double in 'Pups Save a Rubble-Double', then in 'Pups Save a Clown', Humdinger and his kittens when they mess around with Toodles the Clown's clown car.
A fish has gone missing from Grandad's pond and his plastic 'scare' heron appears to have come to life! Stan and Gran suspect something fishy is going on!
Pups Save an Extreme Lunch: Daring Danny X is performing a new stunt. He is harnessed over a canyon eating an extreme lunch when the wind blows him upside down! [SL]
Join Tim Rex, brother Tommy, sister Tia, and Triceratops bestie Kai as they tackle kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions! Tim, Tommy, Tia and Dad get stuck on a remote asteroid.

Some pufflings get lost in 'Paddington's Puffling Rescue', then in 'Paddington Goes Under The Sea', Paddington enjoys a diving adventure with Jonathan and Judy - but where is her necklace? (S3, ep 11)
Acu ends up with Mica's Marsup Journal in 'Houbi Houba Heist', then in 'Twister's Treehouse', Twister builds his own house.
Tim has a clear out of all his old stuff but soon finds not all of it is destined for the rubbish tip.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tia's new balloon gets stuck in a tree, so Tim tries to get it down.
Paddington has to decide whether to support England or Peru before the football match, but he loves both countries. It's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still time for one last adventure.
pr.sub: Paddington's Football DIlemma; Paddington Has to Say Goodbye

pr.d: Out looking for Gaston, after banning him from the castle, the elves and fairies come across a speaking door which leads to the dwarf mine. Once in, they find they can't get out.
Lucy's Sleepover: Holly shrinks Lucy and her dog, Rex, down so they can play in the Little Kingdom.
It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Paddington wants to make a special cake when 'Paddington Celebrates Mrs Bird's Day', then in 'Paddington The Table Tennis Champ', Paddington & Mateo form a table tennis team! (S2, ep 4)
King Thistle wants bread for his royal breakfast, but there isn't any flour in the castle. Mr Elf takes everyone to the Elf Windmill to find out why it takes so long to make flour.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?
Queen Thistle has a beautiful new teapot so delicate that no one is allowed to touch it. Holly accidentally breaks the teapot and tries to fix it with Ben's help.

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
When Grandma gives Tim a hat she made herself, Tim is super excited, but unfortunately it keeps getting in the way.
Plumbing: The bath tap at the Little Castle is dripping, so the elf plumber is called. It's a bigger job than first expected, but with King and Queen Marigolds coming round, there's not much time!
Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.
Tim tries out some new rocket boots which soon fly out of control.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
Bunty II: Mr Elf has built a new boat to replace the one Big Bad Barry ate. He is nervous when the king commands him to take them on a cruise to a tropical paradise - will Big Bad Barry strike again?
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
Tim and Tia build a time machine to avoid confronting Dad and telling him the truth.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy.

There's a pirate-themed holiday in town, but Zuma isn't in a festive mood. His revamped persona gets tested when a real pirate arrives, bent on hidden treasure and ready to destroy the town to get it!
Stan is intrigued when he spots strange lights in the night sky. Grumblestunk thinks it's an alien invasion, but Stan and Gran are not so sure..
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandma, Peppa and George go to the shed to see what Grandpa is doing and discover that he's built a robot.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
A fish has gone missing from Grandad's pond and his plastic 'scare' heron appears to have come to life! Stan and Gran suspect something fishy is going on.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
An air collie makes an unlikely friend in 'When Pigs Fly', then in 'Familiar Territory', the Creature Catchers try a new ploy.
Ben and Holly are excited when they learn that Nanny Plum is a Tooth Fairy at night. They go along with her to pick up a little girl's tooth, but the little girl is not so little.
When Captain Squid leaves his treasure map in the Little Kingdom, Redbeard the Elf Pirate leads Ben, Holly and Nanny Plum on a treasure hunt.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; after a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds an art piece at Suzy's house.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandma, Peppa and George go to the shed to see what Grandpa is doing and discover that he's built a robot.

Mummy and Daddy take Peppa and George for a day out at the botanical gardens. Miss Rabbit is there to greet them and show them around. There's the hot house, the cold house, the rainforest garden and the laboratory where Mr Rabbit creates new varieties of flowers. Last of all, there is the children's garden, which has another water feature... mud!
Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the garden.
Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play the recorder. They practise a lot at home, then put on a performance for all the parents to enjoy.
Peppa, George and Daddy Pig visit the charity shop to sell things they don't need, and things they may need.
Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.
Peppa and Suzy are excited about the sleepover and sit up in bed talking about what they will do when they grow up.
The playgroup visits a nature reserve, specialising in tiny insects, bugs, and butterflies. So Pedro brings along his pet stick insect.
Mandy Mouse joins Peppa's playgroup. She uses a wheelchair and is super sporty. The children have a lot of fun playing together.
Peppa and her family enjoy the apple tree at the top of the hill. It has a swing on it that they all like to swing on and Peppa has a special song for it.
Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.

Peppa and George are watching a television show about Detective Potato and how he helps people find things. Daddy needs to buy some gravel so Peppa and George go with him. They park the car in a very large car park, but when they return, they can't remember where they parked it. Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel arrive to help Daddy Pig but have no luck. Suddenly, Detective Potato appears and saves the day.
At the climbing centre, Grampy Rabbit teaches the children about mountain climbing. For the really high climbing wall, Grampy attaches safety ropes to the children so they don't fall.
A new synthesiser arrives for Daddy Pig, and his family collect sounds for it from around the house while he is out at work.
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; the first stop is the biggest potato in the world; when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Mummy Pig dresses as a firefighter to practise fighting fires at the fire station with the other mummies. The fire brigade demonstrates how to do so effectively using their motto, Ready, Steady, Go.
For World Book Day, the playgroup must dress up as a character from their favourite book. But Peppa can't decide which as she has so many favourites.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.

Peppa and her friends head to the trampoline park where Miss Rabbit shows them how to bounce. As Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Mummy Sheep watch the children play, they decide they want to have a go at trampolining.
Peppa and George learn some wonderful magic words. Nice things happen when they say please and thank you.

While Peppa and her friends are at playgroup, Madame Gazelle tells them about a lucky hamper of goodies they are going to make and place in a charity raffle. The project is a huge success, as the children gather fruit from their homes.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.

Mummy Rabbit comes to visit with a big tummy. Everyone is excited to find out there is a baby rabbit inside, but they are in for an even bigger surprise! The children think of ideas for names beginning with 'R.'

Grandpa and Granny Pig take Peppa, George and all their friends on a boat trip to Pirate Island. On the island, Grandpa shows everyone how to use his metal detector to find treasure, and they all build a big sandcastle.

Peppa and family have all gone to the caves for a day out and Grampy Rabbit is their tour guide. Peppa and George are excited to see the pretty caves and go through the underground lakes. Daddy Pig must be at his bravest on this trip to go on the scary 'Ride of Doom'.
Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and the family to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house to drop off their shopping, but that's not the last trip of the day for her.
Teddy needs mending and cleaning after rolling down hills and jumping in muddy puddles, so Peppa takes her to Miss Rabbit's Doll Hospital.
Granny and Grandpa Pig have a beautiful little boat, and Peppa and George are spending the day on the river with them.

It is school project time for Peppa and her friends, which means they have to build castles and bring them into playgroup. Mummy and Daddy Pig have lots of fun helping Peppa make hers, if only they could find the glitter.
Peppa and her playgroup friends go with Madame Gazelle to visit Pedro Pony, who is poorly in hospital.

It is time for a day out and Peppa, George, Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Suzy Sheep all go to visit Tiny Land. They see tiny dinosaurs, their favourite tiny landmarks and even a tiny Miss Rabbit doing even more jobs.
Peppa and George help Mummy Pig tidy up the breakfast things. Mummy Pig teaches them how to recycle the bottles and newspapers, then they take everything to Miss Rabbit at the recycling plant.
Peppa and her family visit a museum, and Peppa likes the Kings and Queens room, whereas George's favourite is the dinosaur room.
Peppa's family is staying at Cousin Chloe's house. It's been a long day and everyone is tired and sleepy, but baby Alexander keeps everyone awake with his crying.
When Grandpa Pig puts up a tent in his garden, Peppa and her friends decide that it's a perfect place to put on a circus. With Peppa as the ringmaster, the show can begin.
Peppa and George are playing in the garden when they hear a strange noise. It's thunder. Peppa and George are a little bit frightened at first but Peppa soon decides that she loves thunderstorms.
Peppa and her family spot a rainbow when they go for a drive.
Peppa and her family are trying to get to the playground, but Mr Bull's roadworks are in the way.
Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding the chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.
Peppa's family embarks on an adventure, but Daddy Pig's fear of heights threatens their climb to the monkey tree.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.

Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check-up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and listens to Mummy tell him all about the changes Peppa has gone through.
Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the 'Super Potato' film.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa's house and have a fun dinosaur party.
Peppa helps out with Danny Dog refurbishing his bedroom, and imagines a pirate adventure along the way.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
Peppa and her friends are at their clubhouse. They decide to start a detective club, and when Daddy Pig loses his car keys, they have a real mystery to solve.
While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.
Mummy Pig shows Peppa how to play pretend by teaching her how to wink. Zoe Zebra comes to play with Peppa and brings along her toy monkey. Peppa pretends Monkey has a cough.
Peppa and her family go bowling at the Peppatown Bowling Alley.
Peppa and her friends visit a roller disco organised by Madame Gazelle. After skating along to nursery rhymes, they go wild to the rhythm of the music together with Madame Gazelle.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Peppa and George join Grandma Piggy and her friends to play a game pretending to be Vikings. The Vikings enjoy Grandpa Piggy's boat until they realise they forgot about the picnic.
Peppa learns that Mummy Pig used to keep a diary when she was her age, so Peppa decides to give it a try.
PC Panda brings his twin daughters to playgroup Peggy and Pandora Panda. They love puzzles and to solve mysteries just like their dad.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig. Grandpa builds a special hiding hut to watch birds in so they can all go owl-spotting.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Doctor Hamster comes to school to talk about butterflies. Doctor Hamster shows the children some colourful caterpillars and all the children draw pictures of caterpillars. One caterpillar forms a chrysalis that opens to reveal a pretty butterfly. The children paint butterfly wings and dance the life cycle of a butterfly.
Grandpa Pig hides some pirate treasure in his garden, and when Peppa and George come, they have to look for it, using a map and following the clues.
When the family goes to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house for dinner, George is reluctant to eat his salad.

After Peppa's tooth falls out, Mummy Pig explains that the Tooth Fairy will come that very night to take the tooth and leave a shiny coin in its place. Peppa plans to stay awake all night to see the Tooth Fairy.

It's time for playgroup, and Peppa and friends are thinking about what they want to be when they grow up. Some in the group want to be nurses, police officers and even pirates, but Peppa takes a little while to figure out what she wants to be.
Grandpa Pig pops round with some seeds for Peppa and George to plant, with Daddy Pig helping out by acting as a scarecrow.

Peppa and George love jumping in muddy puddles, even when it's raining, but when George takes off his rain hat he catches a cold. After plenty of rest and some warm milk and honey, George begins to feel much better.

Grandpa and Granny Pig show and share with Peppa and George their toys and hobbies. Granny shows her special doll from childhood and Grandpa his love of building toy planes. Peppa and George have great fun when Grandpa reveals his new biggest plane ever that even George can fit in.

Daddy Pig takes Peppa and George to school on their scooters. When he decides that it would be quicker to ride back, he discovers that riding scooters is great fun. Mummy Pig thinks that they are fun too and they both ride the scooters.

George eats his breakfast too quickly and gets hiccups, so Peppa tries to help him get rid of them. After trying everything else, there is only one solution left for Peppa to cure him with - to scare him!
Peppa's playgroup is putting on a play, and Peppa is going to be Little Red Riding Hood.
When Mummy Pig helps out at Miss Rabbit's fire station, she is called upon to douse the flames at Daddy Pig's out-of-control barbecue.
Zoe Zebra delivers a very special letter for Peppa and George, an invitation to her birthday party.
Peppa and her family visit a new theme park where there is lots of fun to be had with vegetables.
Peppa's friend Pedro wears glasses, and Peppa thinks she might need them too, so Mummy Pig takes her to the optician.
Tiddles gets stuck in a tree and needs to be rescued. When the turtle falls on Pedro's nose, he needs to go to the doctors to make sure everything is OK.
Daddy Pig reads Peppa and George a bedtime story to help them fall asleep. When George wakes up again, Peppa has to make up a bedtime story to get him back to sleep.

Mummy Pig shows Peppa and her friend Suzy Sheep some old photographs from when they were babies. Peppa and Suzy don't remember being that young, but they are pleased to see that they have always been best friends.
It's bedtime, but Peppa is not sleepy, so Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a story about a pretty princess and a dinosaur.
Daddy Pig has a book from the library that he has kept for too long. The family go to the library to return it and find more books to read.
Peppa and George go sailing with Grandpa Pig, but when he keeps getting stuck in the mud, they all decide to have a sleepover on the boat while they wait for the tide to come back in.
When Daddy Pig needs a new watch, Mr Fox finds three grandfather clocks in the back of his van. Three clocks are much better than one. Mr Fox has everything in his van, even a chicken.
Peppa and George want to be famous detectives like their favourite television programme 'Detective Potato', so Daddy Pig gives them a mystery to solve.

It's Richard Rabbit's birthday party and George is invited. That can only mean one thing, soft play. George and friends have great fun, swinging, bouncing and climbing, but it isn't quite as much fun for the grown-ups.
Peppa and George meet Kylie Kangaroo and her brother Joey. Peppa shows Kylie how to jump up and down in muddy puddles, and they see who can jump the highest.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George go to the park. Peppa and George play on the hopping logs, the bouncing branch and the monkey bars.
When Daddy Pig is given a parking ticket, Peppa and George learn that adults have rules just like children - and that they get told off too.
When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
With the building work complete, it's time to decorate! Peppa and George have fun choosing how to decorate their new attic bedrooms. It's dinosaurs for George, but what will Peppa pick?
Peppa and George are re-enacting the Apollo Moon Landing with the help of Granny Pig's friends. Grampy Rabbit lends them his rocket, but no one has told him it's just pretend.
When George loses the metal wind-up key for his toy robot in the long grass, Grandpa Pig cannot find his metal detector to help George track it down.
Peppa and her friends have fun while painting in the playgroup. Madame Gazelle then teaches them how to play games with parachutes.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
Peppa and George check out Grandpa's new Bug Hotel as lots of insects arrive. A bumblebee cannot find a place in the hotel because the rooms are too small for him.

Madame Gazelle presents the poetry to Peppa and her friends, explaining that sounds can also be poems. When it starts raining, the inspired children create a beautiful poem about the rain and recite it to their parents.
Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure.
At playgroup, Madame Gazelle has invited Mr Potato to lead Peppa and her friends in a wonderfully fun musical Kiddie Workout.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.
Daddy Pig receives a jumping stick in the mail and demonstrates to Peppa and George how to use it. Peppa and her friends struggle with using it first.
Peppa, George, Granny and Grandpa Pig visit the sailing club where they find a juke box. They have fun dancing to all different types of music.
Peppa and her friends visit Mrs Badger's petting farm, where they enjoy feeding the chickens and meeting cute guinea pigs.
Peppa's family embarks on an adventure, but Daddy Pig's fear of heights threatens their climb to the monkey tree.
Peppa is playing with Candy Cat when Emily Elephant's Granny moves out of the flat. When the new neighbours arrive, Peppa recognises her holiday friend Rohan Rhino.
George undergoes a medical examination to assess his hearing. The results of the test reveal moderate hearing loss in his left ear, marking an important milestone in his health and development.

While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised that there are extra rules which she does not have in her own house. On the drive home, Peppa explains to Mummy Pig that different houses have different rules.
The playgroup is going on an outing to the museum. Everyone is on the bus ready to go, except Pedro Pony, so where is he?
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.

Peppa, George and Daddy Pig are excited about Mummy Pig's birthday and have lots of fun preparing surprises for her. When Mummy Pig sees her beautiful cake and opens her present, she is absolutely delighted.
At Peppa's playgroup, Madame Gazelle wants everyone to show the class their special talent.

Peppa and George's toy basket is full, and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post, but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat-pack furniture.

Mummy Rabbit comes to visit with a big tummy. Everyone is excited to find out there is a baby rabbit inside, but they are in for an even bigger surprise! The children think of ideas for names beginning with 'R.'

Grandpa and Granny Pig take Peppa, George and all their friends on a boat trip to Pirate Island. On the island, Grandpa shows everyone how to use his metal detector to find treasure, and they all build a big sandcastle.

Peppa and family have all gone to the caves for a day out and Grampy Rabbit is their tour guide. Peppa and George are excited to see the pretty caves and go through the underground lakes. Daddy Pig must be at his bravest on this trip to go on the scary 'Ride of Doom'.
Miss Rabbit takes Peppa and the family to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house to drop off their shopping, but that's not the last trip of the day for her.
Teddy needs mending and cleaning after rolling down hills and jumping in muddy puddles, so Peppa takes her to Miss Rabbit's Doll Hospital.
Granny and Grandpa Pig have a beautiful little boat, and Peppa and George are spending the day on the river with them.

It is school project time for Peppa and her friends, which means they have to build castles and bring them into playgroup. Mummy and Daddy Pig have lots of fun helping Peppa make hers, if only they could find the glitter.
Peppa and her playgroup friends go with Madame Gazelle to visit Pedro Pony, who is poorly in hospital.

It is time for a day out and Peppa, George, Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Suzy Sheep all go to visit Tiny Land. They see tiny dinosaurs, their favourite tiny landmarks and even a tiny Miss Rabbit doing even more jobs.
Peppa and George help Mummy Pig tidy up the breakfast things. Mummy Pig teaches them how to recycle the bottles and newspapers, then they take everything to Miss Rabbit at the recycling plant.
Peppa and her family visit a museum, and Peppa likes the Kings and Queens room, whereas George's favourite is the dinosaur room.
Peppa's family is staying at Cousin Chloe's house. It's been a long day and everyone is tired and sleepy, but baby Alexander keeps everyone awake with his crying.
When Grandpa Pig puts up a tent in his garden, Peppa and her friends decide that it's a perfect place to put on a circus. With Peppa as the ringmaster, the show can begin.
Peppa and George are playing in the garden when they hear a strange noise. It's thunder. Peppa and George are a little bit frightened at first but Peppa soon decides that she loves thunderstorms.
Peppa and her family spot a rainbow when they go for a drive.
Peppa and her family are trying to get to the playground, but Mr Bull's roadworks are in the way.

Peppa and George's toy basket is full, and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post, but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat-pack furniture.
Granny and Grandpa's pet Polly Parrot comes to stay, and Peppa and George love Polly Parrot. But when she flies away, no one knows what to do.
Grandpa Pig has built a fantastic little train called Gertrude, and when they take a ride, they give all their friends a ride.

Mummy Pig takes Peppa to the doctors for her yearly health check-up with Dr Polar Bear, who checks her height, weight, ears, mouth and heartbeat and listens to Mummy tell him all about the changes Peppa has gone through.
Peppa and her friends visit the cinema for the first time to watch the 'Super Potato' film.
Peppa and George play at Granny and Grandpa's house and have a fun dinosaur party.
Peppa helps out with Danny Dog refurbishing his bedroom, and imagines a pirate adventure along the way.
Grandpa Pig finds his night at the hospital so comfortable, he's reluctant to be discharged. Papa and Suzy volunteer to nurse him at home and make sure he's just as comfortable as he was in hospital.
Peppa and her friends are at their clubhouse. They decide to start a detective club, and when Daddy Pig loses his car keys, they have a real mystery to solve.
While Mummy Pig is enjoying a spa day out, Daddy, George and Peppa explore the rest of the shopping centre.
Mummy Pig shows Peppa how to play pretend by teaching her how to wink. Zoe Zebra comes to play with Peppa and brings along her toy monkey. Peppa pretends Monkey has a cough.
Peppa and her family go bowling at the Peppatown Bowling Alley.
Peppa and her friends visit a roller disco organised by Madame Gazelle. After skating along to nursery rhymes, they go wild to the rhythm of the music together with Madame Gazelle.
Madame Gazelle and Mr Bull lead the children to the wildflower wood to learn all about flowers; the children enjoy identifying the flowers like Wild Garlic, Bluebells and even a rare orchid.
Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Peppa and George join Grandma Piggy and her friends to play a game pretending to be Vikings. The Vikings enjoy Grandpa Piggy's boat until they realise they forgot about the picnic.
Peppa learns that Mummy Pig used to keep a diary when she was her age, so Peppa decides to give it a try.
PC Panda brings his twin daughters to playgroup Peggy and Pandora Panda. They love puzzles and to solve mysteries just like their dad.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig. Grandpa builds a special hiding hut to watch birds in so they can all go owl-spotting.
Mummy Elephant invites Peppa and Daddy Pig to perform magic at Emily's birthday party. Peppa shows her friends how the magic trick works.

Peppa and her family are going for a drive. Suddenly their car breaks down, and it has to go to Granddad Dog's garage to be fixed. While their car is fixed, they borrow a shiny new, blue car from Granddad Dog.

Doctor Hamster comes to school to talk about butterflies. Doctor Hamster shows the children some colourful caterpillars and all the children draw pictures of caterpillars. One caterpillar forms a chrysalis that opens to reveal a pretty butterfly. The children paint butterfly wings and dance the life cycle of a butterfly.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George go to the park. Peppa and George play on the hopping logs, the bouncing branch and the monkey bars.
When Daddy Pig is given a parking ticket, Peppa and George learn that adults have rules just like children - and that they get told off too.
When Peppa decides to walk up the big hill during their family hike in the countryside, Daddy Pig assures her that the hard climb will be worth it.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
Madame Gazelle is making a wicker basket. She explains it is her hobby - something you do to relax. The children discuss hobbies and learn about each other's favourite things to do.
When Peppa goes for a sleepover at Zoe Zebra's house with Suzy Sheep, Rebecca Rabbit, Candy Cat and Emily Elephant, the girls are too excited to go to sleep.
It's nighttime at Grandpa and Granny Pig's house, and Peppa and George have stayed up late to help hunt for slugs and snails. But what other night animals will they find?
Peppa and George make everyone laugh when they dress up as Mummy and Daddy Pig.
When Daddy Pig loses his glasses he gets a bit grumpy, but Peppa and George have lots of fun looking for them.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her friends on a train ride where they must tick off what they see on their activity sheets.
Peppa and family go on a walk through the forest where they meet all of their favourite fairytale characters. They visit the home of bears who like porridge and meet a hungry Mr Wolf.
Peppa and all her friends at playgroup dress up as different countries from all over the world.
Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail.
Peppa and Suzy Sheep are best friends, but one day they have a quarrel over a game of cards and decide they are not best friends any more.
When the school roof is broken and needs fixing, Peppa volunteers Mummy Pig to do a parachute jump to raise money. Daddy Pig goes up too, and has to overcome his fear of heights.

Mummy Pig's book is finished, and it's time to show it off to Peppa and her playgroup friends. Unfortunately, Peppa and George lose some of the book when they are playing, and Mummy Pig has to think quickly to fix it.
Peppa and George love going to the beach on sunny days. They bring their water wings, a beach ball and buckets and spades. Peppa and George have fun burying Daddy Pig in the sand.
Peppa and George go on a boat trip with Grandpa Pig, but they must send Polly Parrot for help when their boat runs aground. Polly fetches Granny Pig and Grandad Dog to rescue them.
Peppa and her friends and family are looking forward to a trip to the seaside where they can make sandcastles, but when they arrive at the beach there is too much snow.
Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoe, Zaza and Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.
Madame Gazelle takes the class to London for the day, where they are given a tour of the city by none other than the Queen of England.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her school friends on a school bus trip to the mountains. From the top of the mountains, there is a fantastic view, and Peppa and her friends have fun hearing echoes.
Playgroup is having a pet competition and everyone has brought their pets. Dr Hamster is the judge, but it is so hard to choose the best pet.
Peppa and her friends are playing pirates, but when they put together a treasure chest and bury it in a marked spot, Pedro soon realises that he needs to follow the trail. He's lost something.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out for the evening. Granny and Grandpa Pig babysit Peppa and George. They are too excited to sleep. When Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig get home everyone is asleep.
Peppa and Luzie Locke find that adults have to work all the time. The children imitate the elders, in the shop and on the playground. They realise that playing can be really hard work.
Peppa and her friends learn how to count by playing games at Madame Gazelle's playschool.
Madame Gazelle gives the class a music lesson. There's lots of crashing and banging at first, but it's not long before the grown-ups visit and lay down some notes of their own.
George has fun making bubbles, and Peppa has fun popping them.

Toris Pear Phone ist kaputt, aber sie will auf das neue XT warten, das angeblich bald rauskommen soll. Also muss sie auf diverse Provisorien zurückgreifen. Nach einiger Zeit nervt sie das und sie kauft doch ein GX. Doch am nächsten Tag ist das XT da.
Lily introduces Jack to her favourite video game, but when he keeps losing, Jack binges the game and turns into a toxic troll; slice of life vignettes that illustrate the modern-day family dynamic.
SpongeBob and Patrick discover a familiar face in 'We Heart Hoops', then in 'SpongeChovy', it's invasion of the faux-chovies when everyone in Bikini Bottom suddenly starts meeping! (S14, ep 2)

Tori stellt einige Veränderungen bei ihrem Freund Andre fest, dessen Freundin ihn etwas zu fest im Griff hat. Währenddessen wollen sich Jade und Cat als Hundesitter in Beverly Hills etwas dazuverdienen.

When Halmoni chooses Jack over Lil to be her Trot dance competition partner, jealous Lil seeks revenge; Min asks Jack to run a simple errand, but Charlie the gibbon intervenes, sending Jack and Lil chasing after him.
pr.sub: The Meatball of Canyon Valley; Sticky Fingers

pr.d: The chipmunks think Dave is in danger in 'The Exchange Student', then in 'Crystal Ball Birthday', Annie and Amber plan Brittany's birthday party, pitting her against Jeanette and Eleanor. (S4, ep 12)
Tori und ihre Freunde sind bei ihrem Schauspiel-Lehrer Sikowitz zu einer Pyjama-Party eingeladen. Er will ihnen einen ganz speziellen Unterricht zum Thema "Method Acting" geben.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: To increase baby love, Baby Boss schemes to change the local soccer team's name from the Hive to the Babies.
Indie helps the pals rehome a lost bee in 'The Hunt for the Hidden Hive', then in 'The Trouble of the Toppled Trees', Sam and Kit try to uncover who has been chewing the forest trees. (S1, ep 4)

Tori übt für ein Vorsprechen. Doch ihre Freunde erklären ihr, dass sie für diese Rolle zu langweilig und brav sei. Da entschließt sie sich, mit allen in den "Gorilla Club" zu gehen. Dort kann man Mutproben absolvieren und beweisen, wie weit man geht.
Simon is too embarrassed to kiss his co-star in the school play; Alvin decides to rent out the family's house for a Hawaiian home swap.
The Twins and Marsups play a game of golf in 'Golfalami', then in 'Mar-Sleepwalker', Callie sleepwalks at a sleepover. (S1, ep 13)

Wegen eines Staus dauert Toris Fahrt zur Schule viel länger. Daher macht sie sich auf die Suche nach einem erträglichen Mitfahrer unter ihren Freunden. Währenddessen kann Cat nicht aufhören, einen E-Mail-Dienst mit Gutscheinen zu nutzen.
Max and Phoebe ask Cherry to secretly fill in after Phoebe injures herself the night before a meeting with the Z-Force.

Robbie lädt Tori zum Sushi-Essen ins Nozu ein. Leider haben beide ihr Geld vergessen und müssen daher für Mrs. Lee einen riesigen Berg Tintenfisch zerhacken. Andre, Beck, Jade und Cat wundern sich, wie Trina das Vorsingen eigentlich bestanden hat.
Planes, Trains, and Kitty Balloons!: Gabby unboxes a passport-like travel book and three tickets that take her on a dollhouse travel adventure. (S3, ep 7)

Phoebe worries that Max will revert to his evil ways after he is asked to give a 'Scared Straight' talk to a group of young supervillains in prison, but her efforts to protect Max from himself end up doing more harm than good.

Tori freundet sich mit der neuen, seltsamen Schülerin Bonnie an. Doch immer, wenn andere Leute dazukommen, verschwindet diese ganz plötzlich. Ihre Freunde machen sich Sorgen, dass sie verrückt wird, doch Tori vermutet etwas Unheimliches.
Scaredy discovers the forest in 'The Tour', and then in 'Smurfing a Masterpiece', Baby Smurf is the new Painter! (S3, ep 9)
Captain Man, Kid Danger and Phoebe Thunderman infiltrate a villain meeting in Swellview where the villains plan to destroy Captain Man and Kid Danger.

Tori findet es doof, dass niemand auf der Hollywood Arts auf Aprilscherze steht. Doch dann erlebt sie einen chaotischen, fantasievollen 1. April, an dem eine verrückte Szene nach der anderen passiert. Das lässt sie wieder lachen.
Alvin takes Simon's place on a camping trip in 'Excavation Vacation', and in 'Trophy Dad', The Chipmunks suspect Dave is lying about the various awards he's won. (S5, ep 14)
When Dr Minyak plans to ruin Double G's worldwide charity concert, Captain Man and Kid Danger join forces with the Game Shakers to defeat Dr Minyak and keep Double G safe.

In Becks neuem Film treten Jade, Tori und Cat als Blondinen auf. Nach Ende der Dreharbeiten gehen die drei mit diesen Perücken aus. Kurz darauf lernt Cat einen Jungen im Restaurant kennen, doch sie erzählt ihm nichts von der blonden Perücke.
Mica's Marsup journal ends up in Acu's bag, so he has to get it back before his friend finds it. Twister is fed up with Hope and Punch's pranks, so he builds his own cardboard house which Stan finds.
The boys build a treehouse in the backyard and move out in 'Independence Day', and in 'Opposites Attract', an invention of Simon's accidently magnetizes Alvin and Simon to each other. (S3, ep 11)
Plankton nimmt Selbstverteidigungsstunden von Sandy; Mr. Krabs geht ins Fitnessstudio.
pr.sub: Plankton lernt Karate / Harte Schale, weicher Kern

pr.d: SpongeBob und Patrick finden eine überraschende Verbindung zu ihrem Lieblings-Algenkind.

Plankton macht aus seinem Restaurant einen Souvenirshop, aber Mr. Krabs traut der Sache nicht. Er glaubt, dass Plankton noch immer an das Krabbenbürger-Rezept herankommen will. Thaddäus glaubt, dass er eine Schneckenkrankheit hat.
After breaking Papa Smurf's telescope, Monkey wants to make up for his mistake by fetching him a star.
Franz Roll adopts Scissors, thinking he's a dog in 'Scissors is a Good Boy', then in 'Paper's Family Get-Together', Paper avoids a family reunion. (S2, ep 8)
Gargamel needs someone to watch over the Smurfs he's captured. Papa Smurf loses his memory and starts acting like a child.
pr.sub: Lucretia Seizes Power / Papa Smurf Lost His Mind

pr.d: Weil Mr. Krabs seine Angestellten nicht richtig behandelt hat, soll er jetzt ein Bußgeld bezahlen. Also gibt er allen einen ganzen Tag frei. Das gefällt SpongeBob überhaupt nicht. SpongeBob findet eine Perücke und trägt sie fortan ständig.
Handy wants to assemble a team of experts to retrieve his jetpack from Gargamel, but the Smurfs he has in mind aren't available.
The trio sees the latest Moonami film in 'Moonami 12', then in 'Spider Court', the guys are tried for hurting a spider. (S2, ep 9)
Blossom helps a lost bee in the forest, and it follows her everywhere. Dimwitty and Begonia bring Papa Smurf a birthday present, but he doesn't like it and pretends to lose it.
pr.sub: Bee my Friend / Papa's Birthday Gift

pr.d: Thaddäus hat ein Problem: Das Mundstück seiner Klarinette ist ihm im Halse stecken geblieben. SpongeBob und Patrick sollen ihm helfen, indem sie sich verkleinern und in einem Mini-U-Boot nach dem Stück suchen. Patrick will Bikini Bottom verlassen.
Alvin's too short to ride a new amusement park ride; while on a ski trip, Alvin convinces Theodore there's a Yeti nearby.
Another grocery trip devolves into chaos in 'The Real Woori World', then in 'The Collector', Jack pursues a rare collectible DVD. (S2, ep 10)

SpongeBob und Patrick verwechseln den mit Beton eingekleisterten Thaddäus mit einer gefährdeten Tierart und kümmern sich um ihn. SpongeBob glaubt, Thaddäus in eine Eiswaffel verzaubert zu haben, und versucht, ihn wieder zurückzubringen.
The boy's imaginations run wild when Dave disappears; when they finally find him, they're convinced he's a zombie; Alvin tries to convince Dave that he's being hunted by a flying beast.
No Way Out: Dread's obsession with recapturing his shard overrules all reason. Rusty Rose agrees the shard is too powerful for any one person, including Sonic. (S1, ep 12)

SpongeBob hat schon wieder seine Führerscheinprüfung nicht bestanden. Patrick kann es nicht glauben. Er will selbst den Test machen. Patrick erfährt von einem Minister, dass er rechtmäßiger König von Bikini Bottom ist.
pr.sub: Eine Träne im Schlagloch; Königlicher Quatsch

pr.d: Eine Rockerband ist auf dem Weg nach Bikini Bottom und SpongeBob will alle warnen. Aber Mr. Krabs sieht darin sofort ein Geschäft. Die Tang-Sake ist das neue Lieblingsgetränk in Bikini Bottom. Mr. Krabs und Plankton wollen an das Rezept kommen.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: While the Boss Baby helps Tim sell magazines for a school fundraiser, a suspicious baby whisperer seeks to break up the playgroup.
pr.sub: Ga Ba Goo Ba Ga (The Babblist)

pr.d: Brittany and the girls release a video that Alvin, Simon, and Theodore can't top in 'Viral', and in 'Brothers of Dagarack', Simon asks Alvin and Theodore not to see a new movie without him (S2, ep 20)

SpongeBob muss sich auf die weite Reise zum Geheimversteck der Geheimformel machen, weil in der Krossen Krabbe die Krabben Burger ausgehen. Er muss dafür mit dem Ozeanien-Express fahren, doch er ist nicht allein auf seiner Reise.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: The stage is set for corporate sabotage as Staci sends the Boss Baby undercover to take down Baby Corp's latest leader at a company retreat.
The Chipmunks decide to find Dave a new girlfriend in 'Slippin Thru My Fingers', then in 'Driving Dave Crazy', the Chipmunks accidentally ruin Dave's new song for the music festival. (S1, ep 13)

Dora erfährt, dass ihre Großmutter nie eine Quinceañera hatte. Daraufhin beschließt sie, eine Überraschungsparty für sie zu organisieren. Währenddessen sucht Coco den Großen-Geschichten-Baum auf, weil ihr keine Geschichte einfällt.

Paper and Sandpaper are on a train that gets hijacked by The Algebra Villain, who will make them crash unless Paper solves an algebra problem. Rock and Scissors think of the perfect prank call, but Rock bails to watch Franz Roll's pet, Kitty.
pr.sub: The Train Problem; Salmon Delivery for Ya

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Bossa Nova: Boss Baby struggles with baby life in a new playgroup while Mega Fat's malfunctioning Wagby toy puts everyone at risk, and Tim tries everything to avoid doing his homework. (S2, ep 1)

Tim sucht einen Ort in Dinostadt, an dem er alleine Spaß haben kann. Tim und Kai wollen für Parky den besten Tag aller Zeiten organisieren. Als ein Sturm die Rexes zu Hause hält, denken sie sich ein Spiel aus, um sich die Zeit zu vertreiben.
After capturing the Lawnies' attention, SpongeBob and Squidward become a hit new live act. After Cecil stumbles into a pile of underwear, he becomes an underwear salesman.
pr.sub: The Squid and the Square; The Over-Under

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: The Museum Job: When a bathroom crisis threatens baby love at the museum, Boss Baby leads two missions to save the day after a baby steals an artifact, and Tim tries to dodge his homework. (S2, ep 2)

In der Nachbarschaft macht ein neuer Lebensmittelladen auf. Bobbys Familie muss sich etwas einfallen lassen, um der Konkurrenz standhalten zu können. Ronnie Anne täuscht eine Krankheit vor, damit sie einen Lucha-Libre-Wrestlingkampf sehen kann.

Squidward and Bubble Bass are forced to tolerate each other's company on a trip to Shell City; Squidward takes a trip inside the imagination box and must rely on SpongeBob and Patrick's creativity in order to escape.
Rock asks his friends to help him fly in 'Rock's Half-Birthday', then in 'Cherry Picking', Scissors feels left out of the group. (S3, ep 3)

1. Geschichte: Der entspannte Bootsausflug der Familie auf einem See endet auf einer einsamen Wüsteninsel. Können sich die Louds von der Insel retten? 2. Geschichte: Lincoln und Clyde sind davon überzeugt, dass eine Tiefkühlkostfirma die Rezepte von Lincolns Vater stiehlt. Klar, dass die beiden als Ace und Jack ermitteln müssen!

Theodore helps Simon to try and get past his perfectionism in order to complete an art assignment for art class. Simon has a crush on the babysitter and secretly prepares a romantic dinner while Theodore keeps Alvin distracted.
The Stars' neighbour Gladys is a local vigilante in 'Neighborhood Wash', then in 'A Fridge Too Far', Patrick, GrandPat, and Cecil want Bunny to honor their accomplishments on the fridge. (S5, ep 5)

Nachdem die Stars die Nachbarin Gladys zur Weißglut treiben, zeigt sie ihr Vigilanten-Ich, die Street Sweeper, und bestraft Bikini Bottom. Daraufhin aktivieren die Stars ihre Superhelden-Ichs, die Super Stars.
Someone snatches all the fruit from an orangutan's island in the jungle; the agents try to bring some peace to a pair of brawling Gila monsters.
pr.sub: The Mysterious Fruit Thief; The Riddle of the Wrestling Lizards

pr.d: ..Secrets: Uncover everything we know so far about the legendary Krabby Patty as Perch Perkins investigates the burger's history, ingredients, secrets, scandals and successes.
Pat wird geholfen, einen neuen Job zu finden. OpaPat überzeugt Patrick, sein Zuhause zu verlassen.
The twins and Marsupilamis save an egg from the Jaguar, which hatches into a baby crocodile. The Marsupilamis are helping people, and Callie wants to find out who the Amazing Coat Man hero is.
Halmoni kidnaps a dog in 'Dubu', then in 'Jack's Day Off', Jack struggles to manage the Groom & Board alone. (S2, ep 8)

Nachdem die Wohnung zufriert, nimmt Lou an der Vermieterkonferenz teil und Papier will alle retten. In einem Prank-Battle stellen sich Schere, Stein und Papier gegen die Ratten-Bros und Bleistift. Doch Bleistift hat eine geheime Waffe.
Das Trio macht sich gemeinsam auf den Weg, um sieben Limetten von Pipers Schwester zu bekommen.
A glowing lantern leads Gabby and Pandy to a Fairy Fly House; however, to meet their new neighbour, they'll need to prove they're helpful, kind and welcoming.
From Dust Till Dawn: Chloe is struggling with her leadership skills, but when a villain attacks her school field trip, Max and Phoebe have to put Chloe in charge. (S1, ep 13)

Als SpongeBob und Patrick sich Nachrichten per Muscheln schicken, gerät Thaddäus ins Chaos. SpongeBob glaubt, eine neue Allergie zu entwickeln, nachdem er bereits seinen millionsten Krabbenburger auf der Arbeit zubereitet.

Lily and Farmer have to save the village from a slobbering monster. Gargamel transforms Rowena into a Smurfette in an attempt to capture Smurfs, but Mummy begins adoring her because she reminded her of her doll from her childhood.
pr.sub: Monster in the Village; Granny's Doll

pr.d: Henry and the Bad Girl, Part 1: A graffiti gang is spray-painting all over Swellview. While trying to track down the leader, Kid Danger is tempted by a cute girl in the gang. (S1, ep 24)

Als der Zirkus in die Stadt kommt und seine Kunden stiehlt, versucht Mr. Krabs, die Show zu sabotieren. / Sandy verbringt den Tag damit, die Probleme aller zu lösen, kehrt dann aber nach Hause zurück und hat plötzlich eigene Probleme.
Tempers flare when the Chipmunks get stuck in traffic on the way to a show. Simon becomes annoyed by constant requests to fix things and plays dumb until he gets a thank-you.
Henry and the Bad Girl, Part 2: A graffiti gang is spray-painting all over Swellview. While trying to track down the leader, Kid Danger is tempted by a cute girl in the gang. (S1, ep 25)
Um zu einer Food-Messe zu kommen, muss die Krosse Crew sich in der Wildnis durchschlagen. SpongeBob muss den Schein wahren, als ihn ein Brieffreund besucht, den er vorher angeschwindelt hat.

Brittany's dream of being a fashion designer turns into a nightmare when she gets a job and her ideas are stolen. Alvin suspects Dave of being a local bank robber when Dave starts acting suspiciously and giving the boys gifts.
pr.sub: The Devil Wears Rodentia; Career Day

pr.d: Lumpatious: Sam and Cat make a bet with a brother of a babysitting client that "lumpatious" is a real word. Since it isn't, they must figure out how to get it in the dictionary. (S1, ep 22)

SpongeBob würde sich sehr über Besuch von Thaddäus freuen, doch dieser hat keine Lust darauf. Doch SpongeBob überlegt sich einen raffinierten Trick, sodass er doch bei ihm vorbeischaut. Dann sieht er SpongeBobs neue Möbel.
Carl und Adelaide könnten die Überraschungsparty verderben. Bobby testet eine neue Geschäftsidee.

Scissors thinks he's finally discovered his thing when he joins forces with the sleep-themed villain Dreamscape. Rock is sick and can't lead the Robo Car Wash in the Car Wash Nationals dance competition, leaving it to Paper and Scissors.
pr.sub: Scissors, the Supervillain; Car Wash Nationals

pr.d: Lay Lay is the best friend anyone could ever want - but she's only an inspirational app. When Sadie makes a wish, Lay Lay is magically brought to life. Now, these two best friends can do anything!

Nachdem er CJs beeindruckende Twist-Akrobatik gesehen hat, hilft Par CJ beim Training für einen Werbeschild-Wirbel-Wettbewerb. Als Adelaide einen Zahn verliert, erzählen ihr Carl und Bobby von El Raton, der lateinamerikanischen Zahnfee.

Rock, Paper and Scissors have a great time birdwatching until they return home to find the birds have started watching them; the trio discovers they're trapped in a nightmare and must wake up before one of them wets the bed.
Give Me a Break-Up: Phoebe's relationship with her superhero boyfriend is put to the test when he is offered an assignment overseas. (S3, ep 7)

Lucy will einen Vampir, der nach Royal Woods gezogen ist, überreden, sie und ihre Freunde ebenfalls in Vampire zu verwandeln. Zudem geht es darum, dass Lucy im Hinterhof Dinoknochen gefunden hat, doch entpuppen sie sich als etwas anderes.
pr.sub: Ein Vampir in Royal Woods; Die Wissenschaftssensation

pr.d: Halmoni feels she looks helpless about technology, so she becomes a master hacker and vows to destroy their internet FOREVER! Lily must retrieve a book from the dreaded library: a horrifying maze of unknown terrors.
pr.sub: Halmoni Learns the Internet; The Library

pr.d: No Country for Old Mentors: Despite hoping to be matched with her favourite next-gen hero in the Superhero Mentor Program, Phoebe chooses her dad, and soon regrets it. (S3, ep 12)
Shane findet keinen Anschluss an seinem ersten Tag an der Royal Woods High und bittet Leni, Luna und Luan um Hilfe.
The Chaos Council returns to New Yoke City more powerful than ever, forcing the rebels to come out of the shadows and bring a fight to their front door.
Captain Jerk: Captain Man attempts to boost his image by holding a contest where three winners get a tour of his secret lair. But Henry's friends are among the winners! (S1, ep 22)

Lola und Lana müssen einige Prüfungen bestehen, um bei den Bluebells aufgenommen zu werden. Loris Freund Bobby trifft sich mit anderen Mädchen. Lincoln und Clyde verfolgen ihn, um herauszufinden, was er vorhat, und ihn zu überführen.

Matthew ist vor zehn Jahren verschwunden. Seitdem ruft er seine Mutter jedes Jahr an ihrem Geburtstag an, ohne etwas über sich preiszugeben. Ihre Tochter Caroline macht sich auf die Suche nach ihrem Bruder und entdeckt ein schreckliches Geheimnis.

Madame Maude betreibt ein Luxusprostitutionsnetzwerk. Die Nachricht von ihrer Ermordung erschüttert die Gänge der Ministerien in Paris. Kommissar Le Goff bittet Gréco, mit Fingerspitzengefühl vorzugehen. Natürlich wird sie das nicht.

Der Mord an Frau Maude, der Leiterin eines großen Prostitutionsrings, erschüttert Kommissar Legoff. Gréco ermittelt mit ihrer gewohnten Schroffheit unter den Callgirls, Rose gibt sich für ihre Ermittlungen als Prostituierte aus.

Sport und Turnen füllt Gräber und Urnen, sagen manche süffisant. Das weiß keine:r so gut wie SWR Host Pierre M. Krause. Trotzdem muss auch er in der SWR Kurzstrecke ab und zu seinen untrainierten Körper zu sportlichen Höchst-Leistungen zwingen.

In diesem Best-of von "Der reale Irrsinn" begeben wir uns auf eine automobile Rundreise quer durch Deutschland und zeigen elf Filme, die Realsatiren eingehend darstellen und die sowohl zum Schmunzeln als auch Haareraufen anregen.

Pauline bricht den Kuss mit Leonard ab. Leonard macht ihr klar, dass er niemals zulassen wird, dass Patrizias Zwillinge zwischen ihnen stehen. Trotzdem erbittet sich Pauline Zeit, um sich darüber klar zu werden, wie ihr Leben weitergehen soll. Als Leonard jedoch am selben Abend vor ihrer Tür steht, kann Pauline ihm nicht länger widerstehen. Patrizia passt diese Wiedervereinigung überhaupt nicht. Deswegen konfrontiert sie Pauline mit einer schwerwiegenden Behauptung.

Pauline ist entsetzt, dass Leonard Patrizia Geld für eine Abtreibung geboten hat. Leonard ist perplex, als Pauline ihm klarmacht, dass sie nicht weiß, ob sie mit jemandem zusammen sein kann, der das Leben von ungeborenen Kindern so gering schätzt. Michael hält Andrés Feigheit gegenüber Natascha nicht mehr aus und sorgt dafür, dass ihr klar wird, was André getan hat. Natascha ist entsetzt, André hingegen ist stocksauer auf Michael.

Patrizia merkt, dass ihre Bemühungen, einen Keil zwischen Pauline und Leonard zu treiben, endlich von Erfolg gekrönt sind. Nur leider lehnt Leonard sie nun mehr ab denn je. Am nächsten Tag gelingt es Leonard und Pauline, sich wieder miteinander zu vertragen, aber ihre Versöhnung ist leider nicht von Dauer. Denn Patrizia simuliert schmerzhafte Schwangerschaftsprobleme, die ihr Leonard nicht abnimmt. Deswegen weigert er sich, ihr zu helfen.

Friedrich gibt zu, dass es Patrizia war, mit der er den Seitensprung begangen hat. Charlotte ist unglaublich wütend und fordert Friedrich unmissverständlich auf, die PR-Frau zu entlassen. Unterdessen sieht Leonard ein, dass es nicht in Ordnung war, wie er mit Patrizia umgegangen ist. Eine von ihm gemachte Bemerkung hat fatale Folgen für seine Beziehung: Pauline trennt sich endgültig von Leonard.

Julias beste Freundin, der Transvestit Karla, ist am Boden zerstört - ihr Imbissstand wurde vom Gesundheitsamt geschlossen. Den Befehl zur Razzia gab niemand anders als Julias Chef: Johannes Sonntag. Julia stellt ihren Chef zur Rede, doch Johannes hat unschlagbare Argumente. Der Polizeipräsident höchstpersönlich und auch die Direktionsleiterin Marei Schiller mussten sich übergeben, nachdem sie an Karlas Stand eine Bratwurst gegessen haben.

Julia wird von Direktionsleiterin Marei Schiller zu einem Anti-Aggressionstraining verdonnert. Ihr Chef Johannes Sonntag ermittelt schon länger gegen eine Bande von Produktpiraten, die gefälschte Armbanduhren, Kettensägen, Hochdruckreiniger und Kinderwagen nach Deutschland importiert. Jetzt soll die Bande hochgenommen werden - aber ohne Julia. Der große Schlag gegen die Produktpiraten geht jedoch daneben.

Schweren Herzens schreibt Nora einen Abschiedsbrief und will unerkannt aus der Stadt verschwinden. Doch durch Zufall trifft sie noch einmal auf Carla, die ihr versichert, dass sie ihr vertrauen kann, damals wie heute. Schließlich überwindet sich Nora und beschließt, Carla ihre Geschichte zu erzählen. Nachdem Merle aus Sorge um Erika deren Vietnamurlaub gekippt hat, wirft die ihr wütend Job, Wohnung und Freundschaft vor die Füße und verschwindet.

Nora gesteht zum ersten Mal in ihrem Leben gegenüber Carla, was ihr Geheimnis ausmacht und macht ihr klar, dass nicht nur ihr, sondern auch Carlas Leben in Gefahr ist, falls jemand von ihrer wahren Identität erfährt. Carla verspricht zu schweigen. Nora ist nach dieser Beichte erleichtert, endlich wieder ein bisschen sie selbst sein zu können und entscheidet sich, in Lüneburg zu bleiben. Lasse ist sauer, weil Nora offensichtlich abgereist ist, ohne sich zu verabschieden.

Sarah Marquardt schwört nach dem tragischen Tod von Benjamin Wittenberg Rache. Auch wenn Roland Heilmann nachweislich unschuldig ist, sucht sie nach Gelegenheiten, ihm Fehler nachzuweisen. Eine solche scheint sich Sarah zu bieten, als Gerda Freitag nach einem Verkehrsunfall mit einem gebrochenen Arm eingeliefert wird. Dr. Heilmann ordnet an, sie über Nacht in der Sachsenklinik zu beobachten. Ihrem Mann Alfred gefällt dies nicht.

Nach einem Unfall liegen der Fliesenleger Hans Lambert und der Germanistikprofessor Ferdinand Pommerenke in einem Zimmer in der Sachsenklinik. Der zupackende Handwerker und Ferdinand, dessen Lebenswerk die Rettung der deutschen Sprache ist, sind sich zunächst spinnefeind. Doch dann kommt es zu einer Annäherung. Als Hans erkennt, dass Ferdinand heimlich in seine jüngere Mitarbeiterin Astrid verliebt ist, drängt er den Professor, seine Gefühle zu zeigen.

Marie Huber und Georg Leitner haben bei einer Hausgeburt auf der Alm ihr Baby bekommen. In diesem Glücksmoment erhalten die jungen Eltern jedoch eine schreckliche Nachricht: Ihre Väter, Sebastian und Lorenz, sind mit dem Auto tödlich verunglückt.

Julia Klug will ihre Freundin Karla vom Flughafen abholen. Zufällig wird sie Zeugin, wie ein Dieb einer Stewardess einen Koffer entreißt. Julia will den Dieb stellen, der schleudert ihr den Koffer entgegen und entkommt. Beim Aufprall auf den Boden springt der Koffer auf - und eine Unmenge Zwei-Euro-Münzen purzelt auf den Boden, insgesamt mehrere Tausend Euro. Die bestohlene Stewardess ist spurlos verschwunden - maximal ein Fall für die Flughafenpolizei, meint Johannes Sonntag.

Beim morgendlichen Spaziergang mit Ellie an der Spree landet ihr Teddy im Wasser. Mit einem kühnen Sprung rettet Patrick das Stofftier. Doch im Wasser treiben auffallend viele tote Fische. Vorsichtshalber entnimmt Julia Klug eine Wasserprobe. Und Patrick beginnt, sich zu kratzen. Nur wenig später erstattet eine Mutter Anzeige auf der Wache: Ihr Sohn hat sich beim Spielen am Spreeufer eine Vergiftung zugezogen und liegt im Krankenhaus.

Durch einen Streich der Kollegen versteht Henri schon am ersten Arbeitstag, dass er in der Küchenhierarchie ganz unten steht. Am liebsten würde er alles wieder hinschmeißen. Als Volker ihn wieder aufbauen will, fühlt der sich von seinem übermenschlichen Bruder angegriffen. Volker soll seine Sachen packen und gehen. Henri will ihn hier nicht mehr sehen. Nora glaubt nicht an Carlas Vermutung, dass Lasse Interesse an ihr hat. Lasse hingegen freut sich insgeheim, dass Nora ihm erhalten bleibt.

Carla ist glücklich, ihre beste Jugendfreundin wiedergefunden zu haben. Auch Nora tut es gut, sie öffnet sich und erzählt von ihrer Tochter Edda. Doch die Gegenwart bleibt kompliziert, vor allem durch Torben. Er erfährt, dass es eine LKA-Akte über Nora Franke gibt und bringt Carla damit in einen Loyalitätskonflikt. Henri ist genervt von den guten Ratschlägen seines Bruders Volker und vom ewigen Kartoffelschälen im Job.

André will nach einer neuen Stelle als Koch suchen. Als er und Werner versehentlich im Weinkeller eingeschlossen werden, gesteht er diesem seine Missetaten. Simon bleibt Evelyn gegenüber kalt. Für Emma ist die Situation unerträglich.

Werner will, dass Simon durch die Aufnahmen endlich die Wahrheit über seinen Vater erfährt. André packt die Koffer und will verschwinden. Evelyn kann ihn aber noch wachrütteln und dazu bewegen, Simon einen offenbarenden Brief zu schreiben.

Dry Aged Beef ist für viele ein Hochgenuss. Daphne de Luxe fragt sich, warum wir Lebensmittel erst feiern, wenn sie aussehen wie aus dem Tatort-Kühlhaus. Ingrid Kühne spricht humorvoll über ein uns allen bekanntes Thema: Vergesslichkeit.
pr.sub: Kabarettistischer Abend mit reiner Frauenbesetzung - aus dem Gloria-Theater Köln

pr.d: Die norddeutsche Kabarettistin, Sängerin und Moderatorin Ina Müller lädt in einer winzigen Kneipe mit Blick auf die Elbe zum Gespräch. Wirtin Rosi kümmert sich währenddessen um das spontan ausgesuchte und doch handverlesene Publikum.

Die Themen sind "Blumenbeet stoppt Busse in Köln", "Elektrogesetz trifft Gartenbau in Ammerland", "Nutzlose Solaranlage in Mainz", "Absurder Wintergarten-Streit in Krefeld", "DHL findet Laden nicht in Bielefeld", "Hausabriss wegen Dachsanierung in Bornheim", "Zu tiefe Eisenbahnbrücke in Bottrop" und "Mädchen weiter ausgeschlossen beim Kinderschützenfest".

Rose und ihre Schwester Alice könnten kaum unterschiedlicher sein. Rose ist Musikerin. Sie führt ein wildes Single-Leben und ist Tag und Nacht in Clubs unterwegs. Alice ist eine Helikoptermutter, wie sie im Buche steht. Sie hat zu jeder Zeit alles unter Kontrolle. So verschieden die beiden sind, so unterschiedlich sind auch ihre Meinungen über fast alles. Nur über eines herrscht Einigkeit: Die Schwestern wollen ihre Mutter aufheitern, die gerade von ihrem Mann verlassen wurde.

Ein tödlicher Zwischenfall in einem von ihr geschützten Haus wirft tiefgreifenden Zweifel an Liz Nyles Integrität auf. Sie steht im Verdacht, durch einen Fehler das Leben der ihre anvertrauten Zeugen aufs Spiel gesetzt zu haben.
Liz gibt DCI Wheatley wichtige Informationen, verschweigt jedoch bestimmte Fakten, da sie befürchtet, sich selbst und ihre geheimen Ermittlungen zu der undichten Stelle zu gefährden.

Das Leben in der DDR und die Erfahrungen der Menschen unterschieden sich grundlegend von denen der Bewohner der alten Bundesrepublik. Wir widmen uns der Ostidentität und der Frage, was Menschen verbindet, die in der DDR aufgewachsen sind.

Besonders in der jungen DDR wird Mangel zum Motor für Kreativität und Improvisation. Es fehlen Rohstoffe und Maschinen. Not wird zur Währung im Sozialismus, Pragmatismus trifft auf Pioniergeist. Aus Schrott und Mangel schafft die DDR Geniales.

Die DDR träumt in den 1970er-Jahren von der Weltspitze - mit Plattenbau und Supersportwagen. Fortschritt wird zur Staatsaufgabe, getragen von Improvisation und dem Können vieler. Doch der Plan hat Lücken. Nicht jede Idee passt ins System.

Ende der 1970er-Jahre entstehen in der DDR hinter verschlossenen Türen Meisterleistungen: die Funktelefonanlage Blaumeise 3, die erste künstliche Bandscheibe oder fast unzerstörbares Glas. Doch dann wird die DDR von der Geschichte eingeholt.

Peru ist ein Land dramatischer Gegensätze: Obwohl tropische Regenwälder mehr als die Hälfte des Landes ausmachen, erstrecken sich im westlichen Teil im Schatten der Andenkette gewaltige Wüsten mit einer einzigartigen Tierwelt.

Die Reise geht in den Südosten Perus, wo sich die Region Madre de Dios erstreckt, die nach dem gleichnamigen Fluss benannt ist. Der tropische Regenwald beherbergt eine riesige, auf der Welt einzigartige Vielfalt an Pflanzen- und Tierarten.

Schnabeltiere, Dingos oder Tasmanische Teufel - in Australiens weiten Wäldern leben Tiere, die es nur dort gibt, nirgendwo sonst. Ihre außergewöhnliche Anpassungsfähigkeit ermöglicht ihnen ein Überleben in dieser oftmals feindlichen Natur.
Thailands Südwesten besticht mit einer faszinierenden Inselwelt und Urlauber aus aller Welt.

pr.t: Jack The Ripper: The German Suspect
pr.d: Ripper detective Trevor Marriott presents convincing new evidence surrounding the identity of Jack The Ripper, enabling him to trace living descendants of the Whitechapel murderer.

pr.t: Jack the Ripper: London's Most Notorious Killer
pr.d: Unmasking Jack the Ripper and his evil deeds with a presentation of both factual evidence and conspiracy theories.

Every three days, a woman is killed in the UK. These women could be sisters, daughters and friends. Although there is a lead that breaks open the case, what comes in light of the investigation is one that leaves an everlasting scar on the families.
Carmine Galante took the Mob into the world of heroin and even when locked up in jail, Galante still managed to control the streets and profit from his drug empire.
Ex-FBI agent Joe Pistone, who infiltrated the Mafia for six years as mobster 'Donnie Brasco', reveals how his undercover work led to over 100 convictions.
Financier Allen Dorfman used union pension funds to bankroll the Mafia and the FBI quickly realised they could bankrupt the Mob by pursuing Dorfman.
Joe Valachi was the first Mafia member to break the Mob's code of silence and turn public informer, revealing the term "Cosa Nostra" to the world.
Gambino family soldier Roy DeMeo and his crew were suspected of killing dozens of people and dismembering their bodies, but the FBI and other mobsters were soon on his trail.
Meyer Lansky was an associate of 'Lucky' Luciano and linked to criminal financial operations, but the FBI struggled to pin anything on him – or find his riches.
The final episode of this gripping series reveals what happened when the FBI pursued the five clans who ran organised crime in New York, as well as the fate of two brave informers.
Two ice-cream shop employees are killed in what appears to be a robbery gone wrong. Four years later, the perpetrator of this vicious double homicide is still at large.

Marilyn Kananen has vanished, and her children are afraid that their abusive father has returned.
Two years after a 13-year-old girl was taken from her home, her skull is found.
Cold case detectives rely on old witnesses and new technology to solve the case of the slaying of Lisa Summers, who was found dead with little evidence of her killer.

Fred and Rose West raped, tortured and murdered at least a dozen young British girls between 1967 and 1987, including several of their own daughters. Learn how two of Britain's most notorious serial killers were able to get away with their crimes for so long, how they hid the victim's remains within the confines of their own home, and how they were eventually taken down.
Documentary series examining what led Fred and Rose West to become serial killers.

pr.t: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
pr.d: Focuses on the notorious house which the couple shared in Gloucester. Fred and Rose murdered their first three victims - Anna McFall, Charmaine West and then Rena Costello - because they 'got in the way'. But when they moved into 25 Cromwell Street, the couple began to kill for sexual thrills.

pr.t: Fred and Rose: The West Murders
pr.d: Looks at how a dogged police officer, Hazel Savage, fought to have the Wests' patio excavated when she became suspicious about the whereabouts of their daughter. The film also includes insights from both Fred and Rose West's former solicitors.
In Norfolk, an otherwise unassuming summer evening is shaken by an armed robbery. A vehicle is stolen, and innocent people are shot.

Detective Inspector Burgess of Norwich CID has a problem as the number of home burglaries has rocketed. Looking at the evidence, officers suspect that one man is potentially responsible for a large part of the spike in residential crime.
After a raid on a cannabis factory, nine people are arrested, and it is up to the team to get to the bottom of which role each suspect played.
The team in Norwich gather evidence about a single-punch attack that has left a man seriously injured, and there are no willing witnesses.

pr.t: Wayne Couzens: Killer in Plain Sight
pr.d: Using interviews with expert witnesses, detectives and members of law enforcement, it reveals the true story of Wayne Couzens, asks how he was able to hide from scrutiny for so long, and considers the larger problem of misogyny in the police force.
At 14 years old, Daniel Bartlam killed his mother with a claw hammer then sought to cover his tracks by concocting a story that came straight from a soap opera.

A thousand elephants come together in a crucial annual gathering in northern Kenya, whilst facing deadly threats from both predators and poachers. Liz Bonnin leads a team of scientists and film-makers, following individual elephants day by day.

Australia's wild horses adapt to threats, using inherited knowledge to survive harsh conditions.
Dingoes rely on teamwork and social roles to raise pups and survive harsh Australian winters.

Esses novos caipiras, que antes só faziam esforço físico na malhação da academia, têm que acordar com as galinhas, enfrentar o trabalho na roça e ainda provar que são inteligentes e fortes o bastante para aguentar as armadilhas de um confinamento.
